features.label: Walked away at 29-0
features.detail: Retired undefeated at the peak, for a promise made to his mother. The exit is the interesting decision.

features.label: Built by his father
features.detail: Trained to a plan set in early childhood. Study the system that produced him, not just the athlete.

features.label: Faith over money
features.detail: Turned down enormous sums on religious grounds. The tradeoff was real, not symbolic.
